'''Dengar's modified riot gun''' was a [[Riot gun/Legends|riot gun]] modified by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]]. While riot guns were intended to disable and disperse multiple beings in an unruly crowd, Dengar changed it to target an individual.<ref name="CCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Dengar_with_riot_gun.jpg|250px|thumb|Dengar carrying his riot gun in Jabba's Palace]]
Dengar could be seen carrying this weapon in the throne room of [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's palace]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> The [[Jabba's Palace Limited]] set of the ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'' first identified the weapon, though the image of the weapon created for the card does not completely match the one seen on film.<ref name="CCG" /> ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' confirmed the weapon was the same one Dengar carried in the film.<ref name="BtM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref>
